source_precedence.use: User-provided requirements, constraints, files, and explicit project decisions. Authoritative for task context, not automatically proof of public facts.
Actual repository code, tests, schemas, logs, production configuration, datasets, and system outputs relevant to the claim.
Official vendor documentation, standards, specifications, release notes, API references, regulators, and primary research.
Peer-reviewed research and reputable technical or industry publications when primary sources are unavailable or insufficient.
Forums, issue discussions, practitioner reports, and social content. Use as anecdotal evidence, not definitive authority.
